BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   B. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   C. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   B. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   D. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   D. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

11. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Journals Page 14 of 55 1 STRAND 1.0: BUSINESS AND MONEY MAN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Source Documents and Books of Original Entry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Money and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
